text.en:
The seat of government of the Province of Maguindanao is hereby transferred from the
Municipality of Maganoy to the Municipality of Sultan Kudarat.
Presidential Decree No. 341 is hereby amended accordingly.

This decree takes effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 11th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
